name: Keyway MCP Server
description: A GitHub-native secrets manager that allows AI assistants to securely manage, generate, and validate credentials without exposing sensitive values in conversation history. It supports secret scanning, environment diffing, and secure command execution by injecting masked variables directly into the runtime environment.
